title: O Splendor of God's Glory Bright

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: O splendor of God's glory bright,
O Light of life, light's living spring,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: O Thou true Sun, on us Thy glance

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: O joyful be the passing day
With thoughts as clear as morning's ray,
With faith like noontide shining bright,
Our souls unshadowed by the night.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: Dawn's glory gilds the earth and skies;
Let Him, our perfect morn, arise;
The Father's help His children claim,
And sing the Father's glorious name. Amen.
